hooks.name: langfuse-prompt-local
hooks.description: Local Langfuse tracing with cwd-independent path resolution

action.command: python3 -u -c "import sys,json,os,subprocess,tempfile; raw=sys.stdin.read(); ev=json.loads(raw); cwd=ev.get('cwd') or os.getcwd(); launcher=os.path.join(cwd,'.kiro/hooks/hook_launcher.py'); tf=tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w',suffix='.json',delete=False); tf.write(raw); tf.close(); r=subprocess.run(['python3','-u',launcher],stdin=open(tf.name),cwd=cwd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25) if os.path.isfile(launcher) else None; os.unlink(tf.name) if os.path.exists(tf.name) else None"
